$comment: A LEVEL-1 DENSITY prior. Data only, no code. Built offline from live_priors via scripts/bake-level1-density-prior.mjs; nothing in packages/ hardcodes any of it.

provenance.source: live_priors sample of 32 documents, each read through readLevel0 with its own defaults; settled claims binned at BIN_SIZE=20 (read.mjs's own level-1 grain)

notes: Per-bin settled-density distribution across real books: what a level-1 bin looks like when a real book is actually read. Seeded into the level-1 density tier before the first bin, gamma-faded each observed bin, re-injected by the document's own bins (tiers.js's own decay) — so a level-1 read compares its opening to other books and slowly becomes its own genre.

Overwhelmingly D0 (a bin with no settled level-0 claim): most of any book settles nothing. The genre seed's value is exactly that the OPENING bins of a real book are placed against this, not against a degenerate all-zero null.
samples: every non-zero per-bin density observed, in density units (a bin of density 1 contributes 1). stateCounts cover ALL bins, including D0 — the overwhelming majority.

This prior does NOT fix level-1 STRUCTURE: existenceDependencyTest builds its null from the document's own density, and a sparse density degenerates that null by construction (SEED.md #3 refuses rather than guesses). Measured per-document as structureAbove.
